page.overview:
What is Dominion?

The Dominion was a Star Destroyer at the time of the Liberation of Kashyyyk At this time, it was infiltrated by New Republic forces, and used to attack two other Star Destroyers over Kashyyyk, the Neutralizer and the Vitiator, the latter of which it destroyed.
